Name: Xtardew Fix - Hide Extra NPCs on Map
Author: yhzx
Description:
Ok, now i got it

Thanks to Kemul and [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193983051-lingling01/]LingLing01[/url] for the original concept and authorization. This mod is based on their great work for the Xtardew community :D

------------
This wasn’t my original idea!!!

I was browsing Nexus one day and saw a mod with a similar function. But when I tried to redownload it a few days later, I couldn’t find it anymore. So I followed the tutorial for NPC Map Locations and made this one myself.

If anyone can point me to the original mod, or if this patch infringes on anyone’s work, please let me know and I will take it down immediately.

Also, this isn’t a complicated mod at all—it just hides the extra temporary NPC head icons registered by Xtardew from the map.
